description: Gene inputs centered and clipped at 100 kb
underlying_full_precision: NO 100 kb clip exists in the published mammalian-ortholog path. 1,487 of 16,734 stored loci (8.9%) exceed 100 kb, up to 1,522,218 bp.
generating_code: the only EVO2_MAX_LEN = 100_000 in the repo is deprecated/publication-obsolete-shared/files/scripts/sample_human_genes.py:36, from the retired human-paralog panel
verification_command: uv run python -c "import json,glob,numpy as np;L=[len(json.load(open(f))['locus_seq']) for f in glob.glob('data/mammalian_orthologs/loci/*.json') if 'locus_seq' in json.load(open(f))];L=np.array(L);print('n',len(L),'median',int(np.median(L)),'max',L.max());print('over 100kb:',(L>100000).sum());print('over 192kb:',(L>192000).sum())"; grep -rn '100_000' deprecated/publication-obsolete-shared/files/scripts/sample_human_genes.py
notes: What actually happens: contiguous 8,000 bp windows up to MAX_WINDOWS = 24 (embed_cds_masked_mammal.py:57), i.e. an effective 192 kb budget. Beyond that the windows are EVENLY SPACED rather than contiguous, so 712 loci (4.25%) are sampled with gaps rather than fully tiled - which also qualifies the paper's 're-stitched before aggregation'.
